title: Machine-readable result transport still requires host JSON
observed_need: Expose a stable result document to mncs-actions and future Forge without losing typed native values or structured diagnostics.
current_language_behavior: MNCS values are bounded and typed, but the external request/result ABI uses host-owned JSON serialization and MNCS has no open-vocabulary string/text value for arbitrary protocol fields.
why_insufficient: The native semantic record can be returned, but the action-facing check-result wrapper, paths, and diagnostic text cannot yet be authored and serialized entirely by MNCS.
minimal_reproducer: tools/mncs_test.py emits mncs.test-result/1 and mncs.check-result/1 after receiving the typed record from mncs execute.
desired_direction: A versioned native serialization/protocol library for bounded structured results, with explicit text/bytes policy and lossless adapter projections.
workaround: Python JSON is a transport adapter only; native assertions and suite verdicts remain typed MNCS records and the raw native execution output is preserved.
